scope: Synthetic lumped analytical screening seed. No PDK, Spectre, circuit performance or acceptance result.

definitions.transfer: Vout/Vopen-circuit-Thevenin-source and Vout/Vin actual ladder input pin. No terminating resistor at output.
definitions.damping: Rs is Thevenin source series damping. Optional 1.5ohm constant ESR per full inductor split equally over L/2 arms. Ideal shunt caps and pure capacitive load; no implicit 50ohm shunt termination.
definitions.delay: Phase delay = -unwrapped_phase/(2pi*f). Group delay = -dphase/domega, central difference. Effective broadband delay fits phase slope through origin over the declared 14–56GHz grid. Min/max and ripple retain dispersion.
definitions.modal: P/N independent legs, Vd=Vp-Vn, Vcm=(Vp+Vn)/2. Hdd=(Hp+Hn)/2; Hdc=Hp-Hn. Equal-code 7/7 is reference. Complementary 0..15 pairs have fixed nominal total capacitance, which does not guarantee fixed common delay.
definitions.ideal_comparison: Pure opposite delay offsets ±delta/2 about one constant reference mean; this comparison uses known design targets, not a physical detector or trim-code algorithm.
definitions.power_noise: Passive synthetic response does not estimate physical power, switching/control/driver overhead, or noise.
